items.claim: Miller wants to keep opponents at the end of his straight punches at a longer range.
items.quote: he wants to keep Goff at the end of his punches at his straight punches clear out here.

items.claim: Goff wants to fight closer in the dirty boxing and half-collar tie range.
items.quote: he wants to kind of just keep that like half collar tie or or even just like his head in your chest... He wants to be a little bit closer

items.claim: Miller has good head movement, high accuracy, and a steady stream of volume.
items.quote: Miller's got good head movement. He's very accurate and he's got good steady volume.

items.claim: Miller has good counter wrestling and takedown defense that improves as the fight goes on.
items.quote: Wrestling wise, he's got good counter wrestling... good enough takedown defense that seems to get better as the fight goes on.

items.claim: Miller is very hard to hold down due to his good scrambles.
items.quote: he's really hard to hold down. He's got good scrambles and he just works back up.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos has a record of two wins and three losses in her last five fights.
items.quote: Amanda Lamos, two and three in her last five fights.

items.claim: Alexia Tanara has a record of 14 wins and 1 loss, going 5-0 in her last five fights.
items.quote: Alexia Tanara 14-1, 5-0 in the last five.

items.claim: Alexia Tanara avenged her only career loss by defeating Bruna Brazil in a rematch.
items.quote: She lost to Bruna Brazil early in her fight career... She beat her in the rematch.

items.claim: Tanara has good striking with high volume and heavy one-twos, and typically comes forward.
items.quote: She's good. Good in the striking. She's got a lot of volume and a lot of those heavy onet twos. That's what she's going to throw. She's going to come forward and sling heavy on one twos.
